purpose: Attribute concurrent SPQR factor residency during one-level cube Schwarz search.

measurement.rank_certificate: rigorous LocalSupport when available; bounded SPQR fallback retained

factor_metrics.owned_factor_bytes: CHOLMOD current allocations plus owned sparse design/R arrays; an estimate separate from RSS
factor_metrics.rss: process-tree sampled RSS from the experiment watchdog
factor_metrics.peak_factor_snapshot: CHOLMOD process high-water RSS observed at factor/resource-stage events, with active factor IDs and generations

build.instrumentation: test-only factor residency and resource-stage capture

superseded_reason: The first instrumentation did not census a factor while it was under construction, so its 1024/2048 partial RSS-limit snapshots could not identify the overlapping generations. Raw r1 files are retained for provenance; r2 adds in-flight factor records and preserves the stage-entry snapshot.
